ALMANAC_GRAFT_HELP: Grafts cost the catalyst seed plus a fee. The base plant must be grown, and each level caps how many hybrids you can keep. Two plants of the same kind can also have a recipe.
ALMANAC_MAX_ON_BOARD: Only {n} may grow on the lawn at a time.
ALMANAC_PICK: Pick an entry on the left.
BANNER_GARGANTUAN_STORM: Storm Gargantuan: your warranty has expired.
DIFF_DESC_HARD: 15% more zombies, +15% bite damage, they take 10% less damage. Same speed and wave timing. Coins ×1.25.
DIFF_DESC_HARD_PLUS: 25% more zombies, +5% speed, +30% bite damage, they take 15% less damage, waves 5% closer. Coins ×1.5.
FAIL_BREACH: The house was breached. The welcome mat was not an invitation.
FAIL_STALL: The garden went quiet: no sun income left to finish the objective.
FEATURE_GRAFT: Grafting unlocked! Drop a seed on a grown plant to merge them into a hybrid, if a recipe exists. Two plants of the same kind can make a twin hybrid too (Sunbud + Sunbud = Twin Sunbud). Hybrids can't be planted directly.
GAME_FOOTER: Fan project · original art · v0.7 hybrids only & localization
GAME_SUBTITLE: Grow it. Graft it. Hold the lawn.
HELP_BASICS_B: Collect [b]sun[/b] and spend it on seed packets on the left. Tap a packet, then a tile. Zombies walk in from the right; if one reaches your house in a lane without a lawn mower, you lose. The bar at the top shows wave progress and flags mark huge waves.\n\nUse [b]speed[/b] (top right) to fast-forward and the [b]shovel[/b] (bottom right) to remove a plant.
HELP_FUSION_B: Planting a seed on a matching plant of the same layer makes a [b]hybrid[/b] - the order does not matter. Plants on different layers (for example Pumpkin Shell + Bramble Vine) can only be fused with the glove. Discovered recipes appear in the Almanac.\n\nPlants never level up in place: every combination, including two of the same plant, is a hybrid recipe.
HELP_GLOVE_B:
Tap the [b]glove[/b] (bottom right), then a plant to pick it up, then a destination.
- Empty tile: the plant moves there (keeps its health).
- Another plant: tries to fuse them, even across layers.
The glove recharges for a few seconds after every move.
HELP_LAYERS_B:
Every tile has four layers:
[b]v Under[/b] - ground cover such as Pea Bedding and Thorn Carpet. Shoots low and is ignored by most zombies.
[b]Main[/b] - normal plants.
[b]o Shell[/b] - armour such as Pumpkin Shell; zombies must eat it first.
[b]^ Air[/b] - flying plants such as Garlic Drone. Ground zombies cannot reach them; only Balloon and Slingshot zombies can.
HELP_LEGENDARY_B: Legendary plants have a golden frame. They are rare rewards from late campaign levels: Aegis Pumpkin, Thunder Root, Sky Dragon, Chrono Clover, Bean Patriarch, Starfall Melon and more. They cost a lot of sun and have a long recharge.
HELP_MODES_B: [b]Adventure[/b] - 200 levels in 8 worlds with special missions.\n[b]Endless Zone[/b] - survive as many waves as possible; your best wave is saved.\n[b]Daily Challenge[/b] - a new level with fixed seeds every day, with a bonus reward.
HELP_TWINS_B:
There are no upgrades or stars: a plant never improves in place. Instead, some pairs of the [b]same[/b] plant have their own hybrid recipe:
- Sunbud + Sunbud = Twin Sunbud
- Pod Shooter + Pod Shooter = Twin Pod
- Bark Wall + Bark Wall = Ironbark Wall
And some unusual pairs work as well, for example Rime Lettuce + Pod Shooter = Glacier Shooter. Twin hybrids use a slot of the level's hybrid cap like any other hybrid.
HELP_ZOMBIES_B:
Zombies have a [b]tier[/b] (basic, armoured, elite, boss) and a [b]profile[/b]:
- Ground: hit by everything.
- Low (Cardboard Box): straight shots fly over it; use low shots, catapults, thorns or explosions.
- Air (Balloon): flies over most plants. Hit it with anti-air (Spine Cactus), flying plants, wind, bees, freezing or explosions.
Slingshot zombies attack flying plants from a distance.

MSG_LAYER_OCCUPIED: That layer of the tile is already used

MSG_NOT_READY: Let it grow a little first

OBJ_DEFAULT: Clear every wave and protect the house.
OBJ_NO_PLANTING: This mission has no planting. Use the supplied defenses.

PLANT_AEGIS_PUMPKIN_DESC: Legendary golden shell. Regenerates when left alone and reflects bites back at zombies.
PLANT_BARK_WALL_DESC: A thick stump that zombies have to chew through. Cracks as it weakens.
PLANT_BEAN_PATRIARCH_DESC: Legendary elder bean. Speeds up every plant in its row and column by 35% and drops sun.
PLANT_BEE_CANNON_DESC: Hybrid of Pod Shooter and Hive Pod. Launches a swarm of up to 4 bees that chase zombies down the lane.
PLANT_BRAMBLE_VINE_DESC: A thorny tangle. Every bite costs the zombie some health.
PLANT_CHILI_DRONE_DESC: Hybrid flying drone. Fire cloves burn, make zombies gag and switch lanes.
PLANT_CHRONO_CLOVER_DESC: Legendary four-leaf clock. Every 14s it slows every zombie on the lawn and shaves 2s off all seed recharges.
PLANT_CLOD_CATAPULT_DESC: Lobs dirt clods over shields and screens. Hits Cardboard Box zombies and splashes nearby zombies.
PLANT_CLOUD_BLOOM_DESC: A flower riding a little cloud. Makes sun from above, safe from ground zombies, and fits over any plant.
PLANT_DANDELION_PUFF_DESC: Cheap. Puffs seeds at every zombie close by, including neighbouring lanes.
PLANT_DAWN_BLOOM_DESC: Sunbud + Lantern Bloom. Makes 40 sun and gives neighbours a small boost. As fragile as a flower.
PLANT_ELDER_OAK_DESC: Legendary. An ancient wall with 9000 health. Thorny bark hurts biters, it regrows when left alone, and it is tall enough to stop Hurdlers.
PLANT_EMBER_BERRY_DESC: Explodes a moment after planting, burning everything in a 3×3 area.
PLANT_EMBER_POD_DESC: Hybrid of Pod Shooter and Ember Berry. Fires burning pods that keep scorching zombies for a few seconds.
PLANT_EMBER_SNAPPER_DESC: Hybrid of Snapper Trap and Ember Berry. Swallows a zombie whole with a fiery bite, then chews for a while.
PLANT_EMBER_VINE_DESC: Hybrid of Bramble Vine and Ember Berry. Lashes nearby zombies with burning vines that splash and set them on fire.
PLANT_FROST_BARRIER_DESC: Hybrid of Bark Wall and Frost Mint. A very tough icy wall that hurts every zombie biting it.
PLANT_FROST_BEDDING_DESC: Hybrid under-plant. Low icy shots slow boxed and ground zombies.
PLANT_FROST_MINT_DESC: Its icy pods slow zombies by half, both walking and biting.
PLANT_GALE_FERN_DESC: Every few seconds, blows zombies in front of it back by almost a tile.
PLANT_GALE_POD_DESC: Hybrid of Gale Fern and Pod Shooter. Its gusty pods push zombies back down the lane.
PLANT_GARLIC_DRONE_DESC: Flying garlic bulb. Its cloves hit any zombie and make it gag and switch lanes. Ground zombies can't reach it - only balloons and slingshots.
PLANT_GLACIAL_HIVE_DESC: Hybrid of Hive Pod and Frost Mint. Releases up to 4 frosty bees that hit hard and fast.
PLANT_GLACIER_SHOOTER_DESC: Pod Shooter + Frost Mint. Slows harder and the shot passes through one extra zombie. Fires a bit slower.
PLANT_HAIL_VOLLEY_DESC: Hybrid of Twin Pod and Frost Mint. Fires three icy pods per volley and slows zombies.
PLANT_HEALING_LANTERN_DESC: Hybrid of Lantern Bloom and Sunbud. Strongly boosts neighbouring plants and slowly heals itself.
PLANT_HIVE_POD_DESC: Releases up to three bees that chase the nearest zombie on any lane. Bees fly over shields.
PLANT_ICE_MINE_DESC: Hybrid of Thorn Mine and Frost Mint. Arms after a few seconds, then explodes in a freezing blast that slows survivors.
PLANT_IRONBARK_WALL_DESC: Hybrid of two Bark Walls. Twice as tough, and tall enough to stop Hurdlers.
PLANT_LANTERN_BLOOM_DESC: Its glow makes the 8 surrounding plants work 25% harder.
PLANT_LAVA_CATAPULT_DESC: Hybrid catapult lobbing molten clods: splash plus burning.
PLANT_LILY_RAFT_DESC: Floats on pool water. Any lawn plant can be planted on top of it. If that plant is eaten, the raft stays.
PLANT_NEEDLE_STORM_DESC: Hybrid of Pepper Stinger and Lantern Bloom. Shoots lightning needles that jump between up to 3 extra zombies.
PLANT_NEEDLE_VOLLEY_DESC: Twin Pod + Pepper Stinger. Bursts of three piercing needles. Long reload.
PLANT_PEA_BEDDING_DESC: A carpet of tiny pods planted under another plant. Fires low shots that hit Cardboard Box zombies. Only eaten when nothing stands on it.
PLANT_PEPPER_HIVE_DESC: Hybrid of Hive Pod and Pepper Stinger. Releases up to 5 spicy bees with a painful sting.
PLANT_PEPPER_STINGER_DESC: Fires a spike that pierces every zombie in the lane. Slow to reload.
PLANT_PEPPER_WALL_DESC: Hybrid of Bark Wall and Pepper Stinger. A tough wall covered in hot spines that badly hurt biting zombies.
PLANT_PHOENIX_LILY_DESC: Legendary. Fires blazing seeds that pass through two zombies and set them alight. Rises from its ashes once when destroyed.
PLANT_POD_SHOOTER_DESC: Shoots pods at zombies in its lane.
PLANT_PUMPKIN_SHELL_DESC: Worn over another plant. Zombies must chew through the shell first. Plant it on empty ground or over any plant.
PLANT_RIME_LETTUCE_DESC: Costs no sun. The first zombie to step on it freezes solid for 10 seconds (Brutes for 5), then stays chilled for a while. Single use.
PLANT_SKY_DRAGON_DESC: Legendary flying dragon fruit. Breathes fire 4 tiles down its lane, burning everything - balloons included.
PLANT_SNAPPER_TRAP_DESC: Swallows the zombie in front whole, then chews for 40 seconds. Brutes are too big: it only bites them.
PLANT_SOLAR_BARRICADE_DESC: Hybrid of Bark Wall and Sunbud. A sturdy wall that also produces sun.
PLANT_SOLAR_TURRET_DESC: Hybrid of Sunbud and Pod Shooter. Shoots pods and produces sun at the same time.
PLANT_SPINE_CACTUS_DESC: Shoots piercing spines that also pop balloons and hit high-flying zombies.
PLANT_STARFALL_MELON_DESC: Legendary catapult that lobs a starry melon. Huge splash, slows survivors and crushes boxes.
PLANT_STORM_POD_DESC: Hybrid of Pod Shooter and Lantern Bloom. Fires charged pods whose sparks jump to 2 more zombies.
PLANT_STORM_THISTLE_DESC: Legendary. Calls lightning on the first zombie in its lane; the bolt arcs to four more nearby zombies in any lane and stuns them briefly. Ignores shields.
PLANT_SUNBUD_DESC: Makes 25 sun every 24 seconds. Plant several early.
PLANT_SUN_MINE_DESC: Hybrid of Thorn Mine and Sunbud. Arms quickly, explodes on contact and leaves a big pile of sun behind.
PLANT_SUN_SOVEREIGN_DESC: Legendary. Makes 50 sun every 20 seconds and its corona makes the 8 surrounding plants work 20% harder.
PLANT_THORNWALL_DESC: Bark Wall + Bramble Vine. Hurts every biter, but isn't tall: Hurdlers still jump it.
PLANT_THORN_CARPET_DESC: Spiky mat planted under other plants. Pierces every ground zombie walking over it, even boxed ones. Can't be eaten.
PLANT_THORN_LANTERN_DESC: Hybrid of Lantern Bloom and Bark Wall. A thorny, sturdy lantern that boosts its neighbours.
PLANT_THORN_MINE_DESC: Cheap. Needs 14 seconds to arm, then bursts under the first zombie that steps on it. Also hits burrowers.
PLANT_THORN_PUMPKIN_DESC: Hybrid shell bristling with thorns: every bite hurts the biter.
PLANT_THUNDER_ROOT_DESC: Legendary root planted under another plant. Bolts race along the lane, striking and stunning up to 6 ground zombies.
PLANT_TURBO_BEAN_DESC: Flying bean with a jet sprout. Plants in the 3x3 area around it attack and produce 50% faster.
PLANT_TWIN_POD_DESC: Hybrid of two Pod Shooters. Fires two pods per volley.
PLANT_TWIN_SUNBUD_DESC: Hybrid of two Sunbuds. Two flowers, twice the sun.
PLANT_VOLCANO_MINE_DESC: Thorn Mine + Ember Berry. Arms slowly, then erupts in a 3×3 area and leaves burning ground.
PLANT_VORTEX_TRAP_DESC: Snapper Trap + Gale Fern. Each bite drags zombies from neighbouring lanes into its own.
QUEST_CLEAN_LAWN_DESC: Win {n} levels without using a mower.
QUEST_HARD_SOIL_DESC: Win {n} level on Hard or Hard+.
QUEST_TWINS_DESC: Graft two plants of the same kind together {n} times.
RESULT_CAMPAIGN_DONE: You have cleared the whole campaign! Try Endless Zone and the Daily Challenge.
RESULT_LOSE_DESC: A zombie reached the house. Rethink the weak lane and try again.
SEEDS_FIXED: This level gives you a fixed set of seeds.
SEEDS_HOVER_HINT: Point at a seed to read about it.
SEEDS_HYBRIDS_ALLOWED: Grafting allowed: up to {n} hybrids. Both ingredients must be in your set.
SETTINGS_CB_HINTS_HINT: Adds symbols to effects that are otherwise shown only by colour.
SETTINGS_DIFFICULTY_HINT: Harder difficulties add zombies and pay more coins.
SETTINGS_DRAG_HINT: Drag seed packets onto the lawn instead of tap-tap.
SETTINGS_FPS_HINT: Lower limits save battery on phones.
SETTINGS_KEYS: Keys: 1-9, 0 seeds · Q/S shovel · G/W glove · P/Esc pause · right click cancels
SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_HINT: Changes the language of the whole game, including missions and the Almanac.
SETTINGS_REDUCE_MOTION_HINT: Less bobbing, flashes and camera movement.
SHOP_EXTRA_SLOT_DESC: One more seed in every level (up to 10).
SHOP_LEGEND_ELDER_OAK_DESC: Legendary seed. A self-healing ancient wall. Also a reward for clearing Lawn 13.
SHOP_LEGEND_PHOENIX_LILY_DESC: Legendary seed. Burning, piercing shots, and it comes back once.
SHOP_LEGEND_STORM_THISTLE_DESC: Legendary seed. Chain lightning across lanes. Also a reward for clearing Pool 6.
SHOP_LEGEND_SUN_SOVEREIGN_DESC: Legendary seed. A crowned sunflower that fuels and empowers its neighbours.
SHOP_MOWER_KIT_DESC: Single use. Rebuilds a spent mower during a level.
SHOP_RECIPE_HINT_DESC: Reveals the two ingredients of an unknown graft.
SHOP_SKIN_AZURE_DESC: Cosmetic. A blue paint job for your mowers.
SHOP_SKIN_MOSS_DESC: Cosmetic. Green, to blend in with the lawn.
SHOP_START_SUN_DESC: +25 sun at the start of every level.
STAT_LAWN: Lawn (or a Lily Raft on water)
TIP_1: Drop a Pod Shooter seed on a grown Pod Shooter to graft a Twin Pod.
TIP_10: Pause the battle to change settings without leaving the level.
TIP_11: Endless Zone gets harder every wave. How far can you go?
TIP_12: A new Daily Challenge with fixed seeds appears every day.
TIP_2: Pumpkins go OVER a plant, Pea Bedding goes UNDER it - one tile can hold three plants.
TIP_3: Flying plants like the Garlic Drone can only be hurt by Balloon and Slingshot zombies.
TIP_4: A Cardboard Box Zombie hides behind another zombie. Use low shots, catapults or bombs.
TIP_5: The glove moves a plant to another tile. Drop it on a plant to try a cross-layer graft.
TIP_6: Fusion works in either order: plant A on B or B on A gives the same hybrid.
TIP_7: Legendary plants are expensive, but one can hold a whole lane.
TIP_8: Turbo Bean speeds up every plant in its row and column.
TIP_9: Thorn Carpet hurts every zombie walking over it, including boxes.
TOAST_BOMB_FUSE: Bomb fuse: 3 seconds. Definitely not a scented candle.
TOAST_TOOL_NO_EFFECT: Nothing to use it on right now. The tool was kept.
WORKSHOP_INTRO: Materials come from victories. First clears pay full rewards; replays give compost and scrap; milestone replays (every 5th level) also give 1 crystal. Tools stack to 9 and are optional in every mission. Upgrades are permanent, tiered, and small.
ZOMBIE_BALLOON_ZOMBIE_DESC: Floats over every ground plant and gnaws flying plants. Pop the balloon with anti-air spines, flying plants, wind or explosions.
ZOMBIE_BOX_ZOMBIE_DESC: Hides in a box right behind another zombie. Straight shots fly over the box - only low shots (Pea Bedding, Thorn Carpet), lobbed shots (catapults) and explosions hit it until the box is torn.
ZOMBIE_BRUTE_DESC: Huge, slow, and smashes plants with a log. Too big to swallow or push.
ZOMBIE_BUCKET_HEAD_DESC: A metal bucket makes it roughly five times tougher.
ZOMBIE_BURROWER_DESC: Digs under the lawn and surfaces next to the house, then eats its way back. Only mines reach it underground.
ZOMBIE_CONE_HEAD_DESC: A traffic cone soaks up the first few hits.
ZOMBIE_FLAGBEARER_DESC: Leads every big wave. A bit quicker than the rest.
ZOMBIE_HURDLER_DESC: Vaults over the first plant with a pole, then walks slowly. Tall plants break the pole.
ZOMBIE_SHIELD_CARRIER_DESC: Holds a door in front. Shots and thorns hit the door; explosions, area attacks and bees don't.
ZOMBIE_SLINGSHOT_ZOMBIE_DESC: Stops to pelt flying plants within 4 tiles with stones. Ground plants are ignored until it reaches them.
ZOMBIE_SPRINTER_DESC: Runs twice as fast. Falls apart just as quickly.
